metadata.title: Dalton Schultz - Quiet in Week 4 loss
metadata.description: Schultz caught both of his targets for nine yards in Sunday's 34-30 loss to the Cowboys.
metadata.analysis: With Nico Collins back from his hamstring injury after missing two weeks, Schultz's voluminous pass-catching role evaporated against Dallas. For as long as Collins is healthy, Schultz is little more than a a touchdown-or-bust fantasy option ahead of next Sunday's date with the Titans.

metadata.title: Dalton Schultz quiet Sunday
metadata.description: Dalton Schultz caught 2-of-2 targets for nine yards in the Texans 34-30 loss against the Cowboys.
metadata.analysis: Schultz continues to be less reliable for fantasy managers with Nico Collins on the field.

metadata.title: Dalton Schultz Posts Another Subpar Performance
metadata.description: Houston Texans tight end Dalton Schultz caught both his targets for nine yards in Sunday's 34-30 home loss to the Dallas Cowboys. The veteran entered Week 4's contest leading Houston in receptions (19), yards (205), and targets (25), but was vastly outperformed by Nico Collins and the wide receiver corps on a day when C.J. Stroud threw for 347 yards. Much of Schultz's production on the season stems from a monster 12-catch, 140-yard outburst against the Bengals in Week 2, and it's looking like that's the aberration for the 2026 campaign -- particularly with Collins back in the picture in his usual target-hog role. The 30-year-old will always be a fringy option at tight end, but his fantasy floor and ceiling take a hit as Houston's WR1 returns to full health. Next up, the Texans face a divisional meeting with the Titans on the road.

metadata.title: Dalton Schultz a Borderline Starter in Week 4
metadata.description: Houston Texans tight end Dalton Schultz came back to earth after a massive Week 2, and he could be in for a smaller workload in Week 4 against the Cowboys since Nico Collins will be back from his injury. In Week 2, Schultz went off for 140 receiving yards on 12 catches without Collins, but last week, he only had 30 yards on three catches against the Colts. With Collins back to take targets as well, Schultz will still be a PPR option, but his limited workload keeps him just outside the top 10 at the position. Schultz still has PPR upside as one of the top targets for C.J. Stroud in Houston's offense, but this week he's only the No. 14 TE in RotoBaller's rankings, making him a borderline starter in most leagues this week against the Cowboys, who have allowed the eighth-most fantasy points in the NFL to the position through the first three weeks of the season.

metadata.title: Dalton Schultz Still Has Plenty Working in His Favor
metadata.description: Houston Texans tight end Dalton Schultz did not do much in Week 3, finishing with three catches for 30 yards on three targets. The bigger picture still looks better than it did a couple of weeks ago. Schultz leads Houston with 25 targets through three games and has already turned those chances into 19 catches for 205 yards. His 12-catch, 140-yard game against Cincinnati showed what can happen when Nico Collins is unavailable, and Collins is not completely out of the woods yet. He returned to practice Wednesday after missing two games with a hamstring injury, but his Week 4 status still needs to be watched. Schultz does not need Collins to sit again to matter, either. Houston has not found much consistency elsewhere in the passing game, and Schultz has clearly remained a big part of what C.J. Stroud is doing. Week 3 was quiet, but his role has been anything but. He heads into Sunday's game against Dallas with more fantasy appeal than he had entering the season.

metadata.title: Dalton Schultz hauls in three catches in Week 3
metadata.description: Dalton Schultz caught all three of his targets for 30 yards in a 19-17 loss to the Colts.
metadata.analysis: Schultz saw his lowest target share of the season Sunday and had an incredible drop of from his 12 receptions in Week 2. The Houston offense struggled in general against the Colts' defense, and they will need to bounce back against Dallas to avoid going 0-4 on the season.

metadata.title: Dalton Schultz - Held to three catches in Week 3
metadata.description: Schultz caught all three of his targets for 30 yards in Sunday's 19-17 loss to the Colts.
metadata.analysis: Schultz crashed back down to earth after recording 12 catches for 140 yards in the previous game. The Texans remained without top WR Nico Collins (hamstring), and only Xavier Hutchinson (51) had more receiving yards than Schultz as C.J. Stroud threw for just 167 yards in Sunday's loss. Schultz figures to remain among Stroud's top targets in Week 4 against the Cowboys, even if Collins comes back.

metadata.title: Dalton Schultz - Elevated role expected again
metadata.description: Schultz is in line to see an increase in targets for the second consecutive game in Sunday's Week 3 matchup against the Colts due to Nico Collins (hamstring) being ruled inactive for the contest.
metadata.analysis: The veteran tight end recorded a career-high 140 receiving yards on 12 receptions (14 targets) in the Week 2 loss to the Bengals, a game that marked Collins' first absence of the season. The fact the Texans were in catch-up mode and the Bengals' defense tends to funnel production to tight ends were both factors in Schultz's atypical numbers, but Collins' second consecutive absence does create the opportunity for another busy afternoon as Houston aims to secure its first win. Additionally, the Colts have been fairly generous to tight ends over the first two games of the season, surrendering a 75.0 percent catch rate, 11.1 yards per reception and tying for the third-most receptions (15) given up to the position among teams that have played two games thus far.

metadata.title: Dalton Schultz Is a Strong TE1 vs. Indianapolis
metadata.description: Houston Texans tight end Dalton Schultz had a monster week last week, catching 12 of his team-high 14 targets for 140 yards against the Bengals. He got so much volume due to the absence of Nico Collins (hamstring), who will be out again this week against the Colts. Schultz also had eight targets in Week 1 alongside Collins, so he's a key part of Houston's passing game going forward, even when Collins returns. This week, though, C.J. Stroud will likely pepper him with targets again, which could lead to a big game against the Colts, who have allowed the fourth-most fantasy points to tight ends this season and were just trampled by Travis Kelce in Week 2. Schultz's high volume gives him a solid floor and a high ceiling, especially in PPR leagues. He is the TE6 in RotoBaller's Week 3 rankings, setting him up as a strong option to start in almost all formats.

metadata.title: Dalton Schultz (rest) back at practice Thursday
metadata.description: Dalton Schultz returned to practice on Thursday.
metadata.analysis: After a huge performance on Sunday, Schultz received a rest day to begin the practice week. If Nico Collins remains sidelined, he'll be in line for TE1 volume once again.

metadata.title: Dalton Schultz (rest) misses practice Wednesday
metadata.description: Dalton Schultz (rest) missed Houston's practice on Wednesday.
metadata.analysis: The Texans gave Schultz Wednesday's practice off as a veteran rest day for him after he caught 12 passes in Week 2. He should be back in the lineup very soon and will be primed for more work than usual again this week if Nico Collins (hamstring) is sidelined for another game.

metadata.title: Dalton Schultz Is a Priority Pickup for Week 3
metadata.description: Houston Texans tight end Dalton Schultz carried a huge workload in Week 2 with Nico Collins (hamstring) unavailable, and he is primed to be a PPR producer all season since he's getting so much attention from C.J. Stroud in the Texans' passing game. Schultz caught 12 of his 14 targets in Week 2, racking up 140 yards against the Bengals and posting the best PPR score of all tight ends, even without a touchdown. Even with Collins healthy in Week 1, Schultz was second on the team in targets and caught four of his eight targets for 35 yards. With Collins likely missing at least one more game, Schultz should continue to get a very heavy workload and be a starting tight end in Week 3, when the Texans visit the Colts, who gave up a big game to Travis Kelce on Monday Night Football and have been a positive matchup for tight ends this season.

metadata.title: Dalton Schultz explodes for 12 catches Sunday
metadata.description: Dalton Schultz caught 12-of-14 targets for 140 yards in the Texans 20-6 loss against the Bengals on Sunday.
metadata.analysis: Schultz was the Texans pass catcher who stepped up big time in the absence of Nico Collins. He'll remain a strong TE1 play if Collins remains sidelined next week.

metadata.title: Dalton Schultz - Otherworldly numbers in Week 2 loss
metadata.description: Schultz brought in 12 of 14 targets for 140 yards in the Texans' 20-6 loss to the Bengals on Sunday.
metadata.analysis: Schultz eye-popping stat line came on an afternoon where C.J. Stroud threw for 353 yards despite the Texans accruing a sparse six points, and in which Nico Collins (hamstring) was sidelined. Stroud and Schultz were able to repeatedly exploit the one prominent weakness of a seemingly improved Bengals defense, and the veteran tight end's yardage total was a career-high figure. Despite the unexpected breakout performance, Schultz's role will narrow whenever Collins is able to return to action.

metadata.title: Dalton Schultz Is a Low-End TE1 Without Nico Collins
metadata.description: Houston Texans tight end Dalton Schultz was already a featured piece in his team's passing game, but with Nico Collins (hamstring) ruled out for Week 2, he becomes an even better option with more opportunity to post a monster game against the Bengals. Schultz had Houston's second-most targets and catches in Week 1, behind only Collins, snagging four of his eight opportunities for 35 yards. He doesn't typically stretch the field with big gains, but he is a consistent PPR producer with a large enough workload set to come his way to make him a top-10 option this week. He also has a favorable matchup against the Cincinnati Bengals, who were one of the worst defenses against his position last year. Shultz is the No. 9 TE in RotoBaller's Week 2 rankings, making him a solid starter in most standard-sized leagues this week.

metadata.title: Dalton Schultz (rest) returns to practice Thursday
metadata.description: Dalton Schultz (rest) returned to practice as a full participant at practice on Thursday.
metadata.analysis: As expected, the veteran was back at practice on Thursday after getting Wednesday off as a rest day. He should be fully good to go for Week 2 and may be primed for more work than usual with Nico Collins (hamstring) trending towards being sidelined against the Bengals.

metadata.title: Dalton Schultz (rest) misses practice Wednesday
metadata.description: Dalton Schultz (rest) missed Houston's practice on Wednesday.
metadata.analysis: The veteran tight end was given Wednesday off as a veteran rest day to start the week. He is likely to be back at practice on Thursday and should play in Week 2, barring anything unforeseen between now and then. He remains a fringe streaming option at the tight end position at this point.

metadata.title: Dalton Schultz a Priority Tight End Streamer
metadata.description: Houston Texans tight end Dalton Schultz was a featured piece in his team's passing game in Week 1, recording four catches for 35 yards on eight targets in Houston's 36-31 loss to the Buffalo Bills. While Schultz's lack of downfield ability limits his fantasy upside, he averaged over six targets per game in 2025 and scored double-digit PPR points in eight out of 12 contests after Houston's Week 6 bye. With Texans wide receiver Jayden Higgins (knee) out for the season after suffering a torn ACL in training camp, Schultz could end up being the number two option in the Houston passing game behind star wideout Nico Collins. The veteran Schultz also has a favorable matchup on paper in Week 2 against the Cincinnati Bengals, who were one of the worst defenses against tight ends last season. In leagues where he's available on the waiver wire, Schultz profiles as a priority tight end streamer.

metadata.title: Dalton Schultz hauls in four passes
metadata.description: Dalton Schultz secured 4-of-8 targets for 35 yards in Sunday's 36-31 loss to the Bills.
metadata.analysis: Schultz caught a career-high 82 passes last season, and he remains a steady presence in the Texans' offense. The veteran tight end finished second on the team with eight targets, trailing only Nico Collins' 10. Schultz has a limited ceiling, but he's almost always on the TE streaming radar.

metadata.title: Dalton Schultz - Sees eight targets in Week 1 loss
metadata.description: Schultz caught four of eight targets for 35 yards in Sunday's 36-31 loss to the Bills.
metadata.analysis: Schultz's eight targets were second on the team to Nico Collins' 10 on 38 pass attempts by C.J. Stroud. Schultz doesn't offer much big-play ability at 30 years old, but he's a reliable target in the middle of the field and saw his floor raise when Jayden Higgins went down with a season-ending torn ACL over the summer. The veteran tight end will be a borderline TE1/2 next Sunday against the Bengals.
